name: Puzzle
description: Push blocks onto the targets to solve five short, tricky rooms. Undo any move, restart any time, and finish with an ending screen.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to move (d-pad works too), Z to undo, R to restart, Space to continue
features: Sliding movement on a grid, pushing one block at a time
Five levels you can edit as plain text
Move counter, best moves and unlimited undo
Start screen, "Level complete!" panel and an ending
